metric_evidence.design_coherence: Observed. All 34 screenshots share a restrained neutral/blue identity, consistent shell, borders and recognizable controls. Remaining inconsistency appears in local navigation and filter treatments. Auth Files combines underlined tabs, provider buttons and pill filters, while Plugin Store uses compact rectangular filters and Config uses another segmented treatment.
metric_evidence.typography: Observed. Page titles, section headings and numeric summaries are clearly differentiated. Technical identifiers use monospace appropriately. Supporting text is frequently small, particularly quota legends, log rows and credential metadata. Providers mobile spreads its letter-spaced status summary over three lines, giving routine metadata disproportionate prominence.
metric_evidence.cleanliness: Observed. Desktop pages are calm, aligned and free of unnecessary decoration. Usage tables and provider resources are particularly clean. Mobile Auth Files and Logs accumulate several control rows before records. Config also nests bordered groups inside its main bordered panel, adding visual scaffolding.
metric_evidence.visual_design: Observed. Light and dark themes feel intentional, with restrained accent color and useful provider marks. Dark mode preserves the overall hierarchy. Secondary text, chart annotations and surface boundaries become visually subdued in dark mode. Several nested panel treatments make the composition more mechanical than the strongest mature developer dashboards.
metric_evidence.ease_of_use: Observed affordances only. Upload, add-provider, login and reload actions are clearly named. Disabled saves explain the missing provider. Mobile OAuth presents a long provider list without a visible search or jump control, and mobile Logs places secondary display/export controls before the log content.
metric_evidence.information_hierarchy: Observed. Desktop KPI strips and Usage Statistics tables establish a strong scan order. Mobile Logs begins its records around y=505, and mobile Auth Files begins credentials around y=464. Quota's four legend rows and overlap explanation precede the plot, which begins around y=680. Controls and explanation receive substantial space before operational evidence.
metric_evidence.spacing_alignment: Observed. Shared page margins, desktop table columns and card interiors are disciplined. Mobile Usage retains readable label/value alignment. Auth Files wraps Gemini onto a separate filter row. Mobile Logs distributes controls across several uneven rows, and provider search/sort controls produce a tall introductory stack.
metric_evidence.navigation_wayfinding: Observed. Grouped desktop navigation, active-route markers, breadcrumbs and explicit Back controls establish location well. Mobile retains a page label and menu affordance. Nested OAuth pages lose the visible Auth Files parent context in the mobile header. Auth Files also changes from named tabs to a generic Section selector.
metric_evidence.responsive_mobile: Observed. Tables deliberately become cards, provider navigation becomes a selector, and forms stack without visible page-width clipping. Remaining friction is vertical efficiency. Credential filters, log controls, quota legends and the OAuth provider list consume substantial mobile space before the relevant record or action.
metric_evidence.accessibility_visible: Observed visual scope only. Login has a conspicuous focus outline, forms have visible labels, and several states use words alongside color. Mobile primary buttons are generously sized. Provider row actions and global header utilities remain icon-only. Small gray chart annotations and metadata are less readable, especially in dark mode. No numerical contrast or hit-area compliance is claimed.
metric_evidence.data_visualization: Observed. Quota charts provide percentage axes, reset annotations, snapshot/projection explanations and explicit disclosure that four series overlap. Request flow distinguishes an empty window from a fabricated trend. Remaining weakness is composition. Mobile legends dominate the chart, and projected intervals use a continuous solid stroke despite representing an assumption rather than observed history.
metric_evidence.interaction_affordance: Observed visual scope only. Buttons, dropdown chevrons, toggles and disclosure markers are generally recognizable. Provider reveal/edit/delete actions rely on icons. Auth Files' Default selector lacks a visible label explaining its function. Quota series selectors resemble legend badges, with their interactive purpose supplied by separate instructional text.

top_fixes.evidence: Observed hierarchy issue. Search, two display switches, refresh, auto refresh, download, full screen and Clear logs occupy the area before the first record at approximately y=505. Clear logs receives its own prominent row.
top_fixes.user_impact: An operator checking recent activity gets a relatively small initial reading area. Secondary operations precede the main diagnostic content.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Keep search, filters and refresh in the immediate toolbar. Group display/export options in a labeled menu. Move Clear logs into a separated destructive-action group. Preserve direct access to active filter state.

top_fixes.evidence: Observed density issue. Auth Files uses separate rows for section selection, wrapping provider filters, search/sort and status filters before credentials begin. Providers stacks a three-line summary, actions, provider selector, search and multiple sort/filter rows before the resource.
top_fixes.user_impact: Mobile operators must scan a large control preamble to reach credentials or provider state. Gemini's wrapped filter also interrupts the provider group's visual rhythm.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Use a compact provider selector or consistently arranged filter grid on Auth Files. Keep search and active-status filtering immediately visible, with advanced sorting/display options grouped behind a labeled control. Condense Providers metadata into a short summary plus secondary update time.

top_fixes.evidence: Observed chart-composition issue. Four full account labels precede the chart on mobile, followed by an overlap explanation. The plot begins near y=680. The projected future interval is drawn with a continuous solid line, although accompanying text correctly identifies the assumption.
top_fixes.user_impact: The chart is secondary to its legend in the initial mobile viewport. Readers must use explanatory prose to distinguish projection from measured evidence.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Show a compact selected-account summary above the mobile plot and move the full account selector below it or into an explicit disclosure. Draw projected intervals with a dashed stroke and retain the snapshot marker, reset label and no-future-use explanation. Do not invent missing history.

top_fixes.evidence: Observed navigation-efficiency issue. OAuth Login is a long sequence of similarly weighted provider rows. At mobile width, Muse and the two Kimi variants occupy nearly the entire screenshot, with Codex only beginning near the bottom. No provider search or jump control is visible.
top_fixes.user_impact: An operator looking for a known provider must traverse unrelated provider descriptions before reaching its login action.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Add a compact provider search or jump selector at the top. Retain the important China/international distinction, but keep provider-specific instructions close to the selected login action. Do not remove useful technical context solely to shorten the page.

top_fixes.screen: providers-390.png, auth-files-390.png and shared mobile headers
top_fixes.evidence: Observed affordance issue. Provider reveal/edit/delete controls and global utilities have no persistent text labels. Auth Files presents a selector labeled only Default. Its display-options button also becomes icon-only on mobile.
top_fixes.user_impact: Less familiar operators must interpret symbols or open controls to discover their purpose. The Default selector does not disclose what dimension it changes.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Label the Default selector with its actual function. Provide visible names for infrequent or consequential actions, using a labeled row-action menu where space is constrained. Preserve destructive styling. Verify actual hit areas separately from icon dimensions.

top_fixes.evidence: Observed readability issue, not a measured contrast failure. Small secondary text is used extensively for timestamps, chart instructions, legends and logs. Dark screenshots further reduce the visual distinction between secondary text, borders and surfaces.
top_fixes.user_impact: Operational context is harder to scan than primary values, especially for readers with reduced visual acuity.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Increase the size or contrast of task-critical metadata and chart annotations. Keep monospace for identifiers, code and numeric alignment rather than every status sentence. Measure contrast against actual theme surfaces before setting final tokens.

top_fixes.evidence: Observed consistency rough edge. Similar selected filters use outlined rectangles, raised white pills, underlines or filled gray buttons across these screens. This is not a demonstrated task blocker.
top_fixes.user_impact: Operators encounter several visual grammars for selection. The next maintainer inherits more component variants than the tasks visibly require.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Define consistent treatments for route tabs, mutually exclusive view switches and filter chips. Preserve distinctions between those roles rather than forcing every control into one appearance. Keep the existing neutral/blue identity.

strengths: The interface reads as a professional operations tool. Its restrained identity supports technical work without decorative distraction.
Desktop navigation has meaningful groups, clear active states and useful breadcrumbs.
Mobile layouts are genuinely adapted. Usage tables become readable records, provider navigation becomes a selector, and forms stack deliberately.
Usage Statistics preserves numeric alignment, units and latency definitions. Its missing-history message does not misrepresent absent dates as zero.
Quota explicitly explains overlapping series and distinguishes snapshots from assumptions. These are valuable data-integrity cues.
Primary actions generally use specific verbs and objects. Disabled OAuth saves include a visible reason.
Login exposes connection context, a visible focus state and an honest explanation of remembered credentials.
Plugin screens distinguish global disablement from an empty registry and provide a direct configuration link. The trust warning is appropriately prominent.
unverified: All 34 frozen screenshot images were inspected. Evidence covers viewport content, not complete pages.
No browser state was changed, no captures were run, and no files were edited. Other rounds and council reviews were not inspected.
Navigation, menus, filters, sorting, search, saves, toggles, uploads, OAuth flows and destructive-action safeguards were not exercised.
Keyboard operation, screen-reader semantics, accessible names, actual hit areas, numerical contrast, zoom behavior and reduced-motion implementation remain unverified.
Chart tooltips, series selection, data-table disclosure and keyboard inspection are suggested by visible controls or instructions but were not exercised.
Loading, error recovery, validation, unsaved changes and populated plugin workflows are not established by these screenshots.
Synthetic fixture values, partial quota coverage and empty plugin results are not treated as production defects or backend-contract evidence.
Dark mode is assessed only for dashboard, providers, quota and config at desktop width.
Mobbin references were not inspected because authentication is blocked. Comparisons use professional dashboard craft principles, not claimed usability studies.
Scores are independent screenshot-scope judgments. Recommended layout changes are design hypotheses, not measured improvements in task performance.

metric_evidence.design_coherence: Strong shared shell across all 34 views. Same sidebar groups, breadcrumb, H1 plus meta line, card radius, toggle, and Refresh placement recur predictably. Held back by variant segmented-control styles, black primary buttons on OAuth versus outline Refresh elsewhere, grey disabled Save on OAuth subpages, and two differently styled sponsored blocks in Config and Quick Start.
metric_evidence.typography: Page titles and stat numerals carry clear weight contrast. Secondary copy is the weak tier. Meta lines, helper sentences, placeholders, and table subtext set small and pale, for example Dashboard credential subtext and OAuth row descriptions. Monospace is used inconsistently for counts and timestamps on some pages and prose on others.
metric_evidence.cleanliness: Desktop surfaces are restrained and uncluttered. Sparse states waste the viewport. Providers, Plugins, and Plugin Store leave roughly half the 1440x1000 frame empty, and Logs shows three rows inside a near full-height empty box. Sponsored content in Quick Start and the Config footer competes with operator tasks in a credential-handling tool.
metric_evidence.visual_design: Neutral palette with a teal active edge reads as a credible developer console, and dark mode preserves the system without inversion errors. Craft is flat rather than refined. Card borders, inactive nav labels, and chart ink are all similar light greys, so state and structure separate weakly, especially in dark quota and dashboard charts.
metric_evidence.ease_of_use: Primary actions usually sit top right with verbs. Auth Files stacks three filter layers plus sort and display options before any credential. OAuth presents nine or more equally weighted black login buttons with no search or grouping. Dashboard reports 0 requests while a collapsed disclosure notes 128 to 135 usage statistics in the same window.
metric_evidence.information_hierarchy: H1, status meta, summary stat band, then detail is a sound repeated order. Empty or negative states receive the largest visual weight on Dashboard, including an em dash for success rate. Quota places a hard-to-read projection chart before the per-account breakdown operators need to act on. Plugin pages repeat the disabled warning and the global status line.
metric_evidence.spacing_alignment: Desktop grids, table columns, and card padding align consistently, notably Usage and Config. Mobile shows specific breaks. Usage Top Models label-value pairs form ragged columns, Auth Files provider chips orphan Gemini on a second row, OAuth Kimi buttons sit side by side for China but stack for International, and Logs action buttons wrap unevenly.
metric_evidence.navigation_wayfinding: Grouped sidebar with OPERATE, GATEWAY, OBSERVE, and CONTROL plus a clear active pill answers location well on desktop. Breadcrumb repeats the H1 on every page. On mobile the top bar title duplicates the H1 directly below it, and the OAuth exclusions top bar reads Disabled models while the H1 reads OAuth Model Disablement. The chevron beside the breadcrumb has no visible label.
metric_evidence.responsive_mobile: No horizontal overflow is recorded, and tables genuinely reflow into cards on Providers, Auth Files, Usage, and Logs. Quota loses its View and Window group labels, leaving two adjacent unlabelled pill groups. Chart date labels reduce to two crowded ticks. Top bar icon buttons, row icon actions, and text-only Details controls look below comfortable touch size.
metric_evidence.accessibility_visible: Login shows a strong double teal focus ring, and status pairs a dot with the word Active. Against that, inactive sidebar labels, helper text, placeholders, and No recent requests subtext are pale grey on white or light grey, and dimmer still on dark surfaces. Checkboxes render as small faint squares. Four top bar actions and row view, edit, and delete actions are icon only with no visible text. Selected versus unselected quota pills differ only subtly.
metric_evidence.data_visualization: Weakest area. Four quota series render as one grey line labelled 1-4, requiring legend chips and a sentence of explanation, with the projection shading barely distinguishable and a step to 100 percent at reset that reads as a data spike. Fixture values are identical, which exaggerates overlap, but the single-grey encoding is the observed design choice. Request flow is an empty text box, Usage is tables only with a Not reported chart placeholder, and no trend or sparkline appears anywhere.
metric_evidence.interaction_affordance: Buttons, toggles, tabs, and search fields are clearly controls. Disclosures such as View data table, How to read this chart, Filter accounts, and the dashboard usage note render as plain small text with a triangle. Quota legend chips look like static badges although copy says to select a series. Quick Start rows and Not configured 8 rely on a trailing chevron alone. Unselected provider rows do not obviously read as selectable.

top_fixes.screen: Quota Management and Dashboard remaining quota, desktop, mobile, and dark
top_fixes.evidence: Four accounts draw as one grey line labelled 1-4. The reset step jumps to 100 percent. Projection shading is nearly invisible. Mobile retains only two date ticks.
top_fixes.user_impact: An operator cannot tell which credential exhausts first without decoding legend chips and a paragraph, which defeats the glanceable purpose of the chart.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Give each series a distinct color plus dash pattern and a direct end label. Render exact overlaps as a stacked multi-line with a count badge. Shade the projection region with a visible hatch or stronger tint and label the reset as an annotation, not a data step. On mobile show a per-account remaining bar list first and keep the time chart second.

top_fixes.evidence: Inactive nav labels, meta lines, helper text, placeholders, and table subtext use pale grey on white and on dark surfaces. Checkboxes are small faint squares.
top_fixes.user_impact: Status, timestamps, and per-credential detail are the content operators scan under time pressure. Low visible contrast slows reading and risks missed state.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Raise secondary text to a token that meets 4.5 to 1 on both themes and reserve the palest grey for disabled text only. Increase checkbox size and border contrast. Re-check sidebar, stat subtext, and chart axis labels in dark mode.

top_fixes.screen: Quota 390, Providers 390, Auth Files 390, global mobile top bar
top_fixes.evidence: Quota drops the View and Window labels shown on desktop. Top bar carries four icon-only buttons beside a hamburger. Row eye, edit, and delete icons and text-only Details controls are small.
top_fixes.user_impact: Mobile operators must guess what the two pill groups switch and can miss small targets during incident checks.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Keep short group labels above each pill group on mobile. Enforce a 44px minimum hit area for icon and text actions. Add visible text or a labelled overflow menu for the top bar actions.

top_fixes.evidence: Requests shows 0 and success rate shows an em dash, while a collapsed disclosure states 128 to 135 usage statistics in the same window. Request flow is an empty bordered box.
top_fixes.user_impact: The landing screen appears to contradict itself. An operator cannot tell whether the proxy is idle, uninstrumented, or broken.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: State one reconciled status sentence in the stat band naming the two sources and why they differ. Replace the empty request flow box with a compact zero-state that links to Usage Statistics and shrinks vertical height.

top_fixes.evidence: Provider chips, filter search, sort select, All Enabled Disabled Problem segmented control, and Display options all precede the first credential. Mobile orphans the Gemini chip.
top_fixes.user_impact: Filtering a credential list requires learning three overlapping mechanisms before scanning any row.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Merge provider chips and status segmented control into one filter bar with counts, keep search primary, and move sort and display options into one menu. Use a horizontally scrollable single chip row on mobile.

top_fixes.evidence: Nine or more providers each carry an equal black primary button in one long undifferentiated list. Mobile Kimi China buttons sit side by side while Kimi International buttons stack.
top_fixes.user_impact: Finding one provider is a linear scan, and every row competes as the primary action.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Add provider search and group by already connected versus available. Demote unconnected rows to outline buttons so at most one emphasis level dominates. Use one consistent button wrapping rule on mobile.

top_fixes.evidence: A sponsored APIKEY.FUN card occupies the second position on Quick Start, and a BestProxy.com sponsored line closes the Config form.
top_fixes.user_impact: Third-party promotion inside a credential and configuration surface undermines trust and interrupts setup tasks. This is an observed placement defect, not a taste preference.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Remove sponsored blocks from task flows. If sponsorship is mandatory, move it to the System page below version information and keep it out of setup and settings forms.

top_fixes.screen: Providers, Plugins, Plugin Store, and Logs desktop sparse states
top_fixes.evidence: A single provider row, empty plugin states, and three log lines each leave about half the viewport blank inside full-height bordered areas.
top_fixes.user_impact: Sparse screens read as unfinished or still loading, and the next useful action sits far from the empty region.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Size containers to content in sparse states and place one next action inside the empty region, for example add a key, open the plugin store, or enable plugins in Config. Cap the log viewport height when few lines exist.

top_fixes.screen: Global navigation, mobile top bar, OAuth Model Disablement 390
top_fixes.evidence: Breadcrumb repeats the H1 on desktop. Mobile top bar title duplicates the H1 below it. The exclusions mobile top bar says Disabled models while the H1 says OAuth Model Disablement.
top_fixes.user_impact: Duplicated and mismatched titles waste the scarcest mobile space and weaken confidence in current location.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Drop the breadcrumb leaf when it equals the H1, hide the mobile top bar title when the H1 is visible, and use one page name in both places.

strengths: Consistent shell, grouped sidebar, active state, and page header pattern across all 14 authenticated pages and both themes.
Tables genuinely reflow into readable cards on mobile instead of squeezing columns, with no recorded horizontal overflow.
Honest status copy throughout, for example snapshot versus live usage, collection memory limits, and the third-party plugin trust warning.
Login is focused and legible with a prominent focus ring, clear primary action, and an explicit reversible-obfuscation warning.
Usage Statistics pairs totals with a well-aligned latency table and explains retained-sample limits beside the data.
Dark mode preserves hierarchy and component identity without broken surfaces in the four captured pages.
unverified: Keyboard navigation order, focus visibility beyond the login field, and chart arrow-key inspection behavior.
Screen-reader names for icon-only buttons, toggles, disclosures, and chart alternatives.
Hover, pressed, loading, saving, toast, and error-recovery states for all actions.
Whether quota legend chips, Quick Start rows, and provider rows respond as controls, and their feedback.
Form validation in Config, OAuth alias and disablement save flows, and unsaved-change handling.
Mobile drawer navigation content, behavior, and dismissal.
Full-page content below the viewport on every page, including dashboard lower sections and account breakdown.
Populated plugin, plugin store, request-flow, and daily-usage states, since fixture coverage is partial.
Motion, reduced-motion behavior, and refresh or auto-refresh feedback.
Zoom, text scaling, and contrast ratios measured programmatically rather than judged from pixels.

metric_evidence.design_coherence: Shell is consistent on all 14 pages: same sidebar, breadcrumb topbar, page title and right-aligned header actions. Selection and filter controls come in five visibly different styles. (1) Auth Files status filter is a grey track with a white raised pill. (2) Auth Files provider tabs show the active one as a bordered box ('All 6'). (3) Quota View/Window pairs show the active segment as a dark-bordered white pill and the inactive one grey-filled. (4) Config Visual/Source is a grey-track pill. (5) Plugin Store All/Installed/Not installed/Updates are separate rectangular chips with a dark-border active state. Refresh placement also varies. It is a header button on Dashboard, Providers, Usage and Quota ('Refresh all credentials'), a toolbar button on Logs and Plugins, and absent from the OAuth Login header.
metric_evidence.typography: Sans type scale is clean: page H1 about 22px bold, card titles about 15px semibold. Monospace use has no clear rule. The page-meta line is mono on Dashboard, Providers, Auth Files, Config and Plugins, but Quota's second meta line ('Checked Nov 6… 2 skipped.') is sans. On Dashboard, the Models KPI sub-line ('Updated just now · every 60s') is mono while the other KPI sub-lines are sans. OAuth Model Aliases uses mono placeholders ('Select or type a model ID') where other inputs use sans. On Login, 'Current URL' is regular weight with no colon, while 'Management Key:' is bold with a colon. Pluralization bugs on Auth Files: '1 models disabled', '1 aliases'.
metric_evidence.cleanliness: Most pages are calm, with neutral surfaces and little decoration. The quota chart carries five lines of meta-instruction around one plot: 'Dots are snapshots…', '1–4 overlap, drawn as one grey line', 'Select a series to show only it', 'Use arrow keys…', 'How to read this chart'. The dashboard Requests KPI stacks four lines of qualifiers under one number. The Auth Files Credentials tab repeats the OAuth Disablement and Aliases cards below the table, although those already have their own tabs. Sponsored blocks appear on Quick Start and inside Config > Common.
metric_evidence.visual_design: The neutral/blue-teal identity holds up well in light and dark (dashboard, providers, quota and config dark captures have good surface separation). Heavy black elements dominate some views. Six solid-black 'on' toggles plus black primary buttons outweigh the data on Auth Files, and OAuth Login stacks nine black CTAs. On Quota, the 'shaded projection' region is visually the same as the plot background. Legend chips carry series colors (teal, green, amber, red) that the overlapping grey line never uses. That last point is partly a fixture effect.
metric_evidence.ease_of_use: Primary actions are explicit and specific ('Add Gemini key', 'Upload File', 'Log in with Codex'). Quick Start rows deep-link with chevrons. The OAuth editors explain why Save is disabled ('Please enter a provider first'). Friction points: Quota account filters hide behind a small 'Filter accounts' disclosure. The dashboard shows 'Requests 0' with a disclosure saying 'Usage statistics: 135 in the same window', so users must reconcile two counts themselves (the size of the gap comes from the fixture; showing two sources side by side is a design choice). System's 'Request Logging' button does not say whether it toggles a setting or navigates somewhere.
metric_evidence.information_hierarchy: Page titles, KPI numbers and table headers read clearly. The Usage page hierarchy is strong: KPIs, then Top Models, then the breakdown. On the Dashboard Requests card, the qualifier text outweighs the KPI number. The Credential files card says the same thing twice ('6 of 6 serving' / 'All enabled credentials serving'). On Plugins, the 'plugins.enabled is false' blocker uses neutral info styling, the same weight as a hint, even though it disables the whole feature.
metric_evidence.spacing_alignment: Page gutters, card padding and table rows are consistent. Defects: Config's 2-column toggle cards have unequal heights (Switch Project about 88px tall, Switch to Preview Model about 70px). The Auth Files bottom card titles sit at slightly different baselines because one header has a button and the other a segmented control. The Quota header leaves a loose gap around the 'Filter accounts' line. On mobile OAuth Model Aliases, the row index '01' sits in its own left gutter and takes width from the fields.
metric_evidence.navigation_wayfinding: Sidebar groups are labelled OPERATE, GATEWAY, OBSERVE and CONTROL. The active item has a teal bar and fill. Auth Files shows a count badge. Breadcrumbs show depth (CPAMC / Auth Files / OAuth Model Aliases), and subroutes keep the parent nav item highlighted. On mobile, a Section select replaces the tabs. One rough edge: mobile topbar titles do not match their H1s ('Disabled models' vs 'OAuth Model Disablement', 'Model aliases' vs 'OAuth Model Aliases'). The bare '<' back chevron next to the breadcrumb has no label.
metric_evidence.responsive_mobile: No horizontal overflow at 390px on any page (per evidence.json). Tables become labelled cards on Providers, Auth Files and Usage. On Logs-390, the controls (search, filters, two toggles, Refresh, Auto refresh, Download, Full screen, Clear) push the first log row to about y=505 of 844, so about 60% of the screen is chrome. The Quota-390 chart is compressed, and its 'Nov 13' end label sits mid-axis. Mobile button layouts differ: full-width stacked on Plugins and Plugin Store, inline pairs on Auth Files and Providers. On System-390, labels wrap ('Management UI / Version') while the value column has room to spare. Provider chips wrap one item ('Gemini', 'Updates') onto a second row.
metric_evidence.accessibility_visible: Most controls have visible text labels. The login input shows a clear focus ring. Quota legend chips use numerals as well as color, and the chart states its keyboard instructions. On the other side: topbar refresh, language, theme and logout, plus Providers row view/edit/delete, are icon-only with no visible label. Desktop secondary buttons are about 28–30px tall ('Edit', 'Delete Provider', 'Add Alias', 'Add API Key'). The 'Filter accounts' disclosure triangle is tiny. Long runs of 12px grey secondary text appear (Auth Files 'No recent requests', 'Not checked'). The disabled Save button is white text on mid-grey.
metric_evidence.data_visualization: Things that work: the explicit overlap handling ('1–4' label), the reset annotation with a dotted rule, the y-axis in % with gridlines, the empty request-flow state that names the window ('20 ten-minute buckets, all zero'), the data-table fallback, and right-aligned numeric table columns on Usage with red failure counts. Defects: (1) the end tick label 'Nov 13, 9:29 PM' is not anchored to the plot's right edge. It is about 32px short on desktop and about 2 days of axis left of its true position on mobile. (2) Projection shading cannot be told apart from the observed region. (3) The legend uses different formats for the same series ('claude-workspace-1.json · 7-day limit' on Dashboard, 'Claude · claude-workspace-1.json' on Quota). (4) Timezone notation varies: 'Reset Nov 9, 9:29 PM PST' on Dashboard, 'GMT-8' on Request flow and Logs, no zone on the Quota page. (5) The chart needs five lines of instruction to be read. (6) '1237 ms' has no thousands separator while tokens do ('282,880'). Missing daily charts on Usage are a fixture limit and are not scored.
metric_evidence.interaction_affordance: Buttons, 'Actions ▾' menus, Quick Start chevron rows, provider list items and toggles read as interactive. Destructive actions are red-outlined (Clear logs, Delete Provider, Clear login data). Weak spots: the active state differs across the five segmented-control styles, so the same kind of control looks different on each page. On Quota, the inactive segments are grey-filled and read as disabled. 'Filter accounts' and 'How to read this chart' use disclosure glyphs of different sizes. Config 'off' toggles in light mode show a dark thumb on a pale track, unlike the white-thumb 'on' state.

top_fixes.evidence: Six rows of controls (search+Filters, Hide /v0/management toggle, Show raw toggle, Refresh+Auto refresh, Download+Full screen, Clear logs) push the first log row to about y=505 of 844.
top_fixes.user_impact: An operator triaging on a phone sees about 3 log rows per screen and must scroll past the controls to read the logs, which is the page's whole purpose.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: On mobile, collapse the toggles, Download, Full screen and Clear into one 'Options' sheet or overflow menu. Keep Search and Filters on one row. Make Refresh and Auto refresh one compact control. Target the first log row above y=250.

top_fixes.screen: Cross-screen: Auth Files, Quota, Config, Plugin Store
top_fixes.evidence: Five visual styles for single-select filters and tabs: Auth Files status pill track, Auth Files bordered provider tab, Quota dark-bordered pills with grey-filled inactive, Config Visual/Source pill track, Plugin Store separate rectangular chips.
top_fixes.user_impact: Users must re-learn the selected-state signal on each page. Quota's grey-filled inactive segments look disabled.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Standardize on one SegmentedControl (grey track, raised white active segment, optional count badge) for mode and filter switches. Keep underline tabs only for route-level sections (Auth Files, Logs). Apply it to Quota View/Window, Plugin Store filters and the Auth Files provider row.

top_fixes.screen: Quota Management and Dashboard remaining-quota chart
top_fixes.evidence: Five lines of chart meta-instruction. Projection shading matches the plot background. End tick 'Nov 13' is offset left of the plot edge (about 2 days of axis on 390px). Legend label format differs between Dashboard and Quota. Timezone shown as PST, GMT-8 or not at all.
top_fixes.user_impact: Reading 'when does each account run out' takes text parsing instead of a glance. On mobile the x-axis suggests the window ends around Nov 11.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Anchor the first and last tick labels to the plot edges (start-align and end-align). Give the projection region a visibly distinct hatch or lighter fill starting at 'now'. Fold the overlap note into the legend and move the keyboard hint into the 'How to read' disclosure. Use one legend formatter ('Provider · file · window') and one timezone notation on both screens.

top_fixes.screen: Cross-screen typography (Dashboard, Quota, OAuth Model Aliases, Login)
top_fixes.evidence: Page-meta line is mono on 5 pages but Quota's second meta line is sans. One dashboard KPI sub-line is mono and the others sans. Alias inputs use mono placeholders. Login labels differ in weight and colon use. Usage meta lacks the '·' separator before 'Last updated'.
top_fixes.user_impact: Mono stops signalling 'machine value', so users can't tell literal identifiers from prose. The header area looks unfinished.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Rule: mono only for literal values (keys, IDs, URLs, versions, counts in meta strips). Labels, placeholders and timestamps in prose use sans. Build the page-meta strip from one component with a fixed separator. Normalize form labels to sentence case, regular-medium weight, no colons.

top_fixes.evidence: Requests card shows '0' with four lines: 'Last 3h 20m · current credential files and provider keys' plus disclosure 'Usage statistics: 135 in the same window'. Credential files card repeats 'serving' twice.
top_fixes.user_impact: The top-level health number conflicts with a second count in the same card, so the user has to work out which source is true (magnitude is fixture-driven).
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Keep one number plus a one-line scope label per KPI. Move the alternate source to a tooltip or info popover with a short reason it differs. Drop the duplicated 'All enabled credentials serving'.

top_fixes.evidence: OAuth Model Disablement and OAuth Model Aliases cards appear below the credential table while dedicated tabs for both sit in the same tab bar.
top_fixes.user_impact: Two entry points for the same objects, with different controls (card buttons vs full editor), make it unclear which is canonical.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Remove the summary cards from the Credentials tab, or reduce them to one-line counts that link to their tabs.

top_fixes.screen: Cross-screen accessibility (topbar, Providers row actions, small buttons)
top_fixes.evidence: Icon-only topbar (refresh, language, theme, logout) and row actions (view, edit, delete) have no visible labels. Desktop secondary buttons about 28–30px tall. Tiny 'Filter accounts' disclosure triangle.
top_fixes.user_impact: Pointer and touch-pad users have small targets. Icon meaning (globe = language, refresh = global vs page refresh) depends on recall.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Raise the minimum desktop control height to 32px and mobile to 44px. Add visible tooltips on icon buttons. Give the Providers delete action a confirmation-bearing menu or a labelled button. Use the same chevron disclosure component as 'How to read this chart'.

top_fixes.screen: Mobile header and actions (OAuth editors, Plugins, System)
top_fixes.evidence: Topbar titles 'Disabled models' and 'Model aliases' differ from their H1s. Plugins uses full-width stacked buttons, Auth Files inline pairs. System-390 label column wraps while values have spare width.
top_fixes.user_impact: Small orientation and consistency costs on phone.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Derive the topbar title from the route's H1. Apply one mobile action layout rule (primary plus secondary inline, overflow beyond two). Stack key-value rows vertically below 480px on System.

top_fixes.screen: Config Panel Common section; Auth Files summary cards
top_fixes.evidence: Unequal toggle-card heights in the 2-column grid. '1 models disabled', '1 aliases'.
top_fixes.user_impact: Cosmetic, but visible polish defects in high-traffic config.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Stretch grid items to equal row height (align-items: stretch on the card). Use i18n plural rules for count strings in all four locales.

strengths: Coherent shell: grouped sidebar (Operate, Gateway, Observe, Control), clear active state, breadcrumbs with subroute depth, count badge on Auth Files.
Restrained neutral palette with a small teal accent. Dark mode keeps hierarchy and contrast on all four captured dark pages.

Honest data states. The empty request flow names its window and bucket count. Usage marks daily data 'Not reported' instead of drawing zeros. Quota states 'reported snapshots, not live usage' and the measured/skipped counts.
Specific action labels ('Add Gemini key', 'Log in with Kimi International', 'Refresh registry'), and the OAuth editors state why Save is disabled.
Desktop tables become labelled mobile cards on Providers, Auth Files and Usage, with no horizontal overflow at 390px.
Strong risk communication on Plugin Store: an amber warning that third-party plugins have full backend access, kept apart from the neutral config-state notice.
Usage tables right-align numerics, mark failures in red, and show p50/p95 latency side by side.
